A block of metal absorbs 2000J of thermal energy.
The temperature of the block rises from 10°C to 20°C.
The mass of the block is 2.0kg.
What is the specific heat capacity of the metal?
50J/(kg°C)
100J/(kg°C)
200J/(kg°C)
400J/(kg°C)

B
C
D
